title: User Needs Mapping Model
description: JSON Schema for User Needs Mapping (UNM) model files (.unm.yaml). Validates the full YAML structure including actors, needs, capabilities, technical systems, teams, and their relationships.

system.title: System
system.description: Top-level boundary descriptor. Identifies the scope of what is being modeled.

actors.title: Actors
actors.description: People or external systems that have needs (e.g., Merchant, Eater, Operator). Each actor represents a meaningfully different user type with different goals.

needs.title: Needs
needs.description: What each actor is trying to accomplish. Needs bridge actors to capabilities.

capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.description: What the system must be able to do. Capabilities are the core of a UNM model — they represent durable system abilities, not services or teams.

technical_systems.title: Technical Systems
technical_systems.description: Concrete implementations that realize capabilities. Technical systems declare which capabilities they implement and which external systems they depend on.

teams.title: Teams
teams.description: Organizational units that own capabilities and services. Classified using Team Topologies types.

capability_groups.title: Capability Groups
capability_groups.description: Named clusters of capabilities identified by a tag slug. Defines display metadata (name, description) for each tag used in capability.tags.

org_groups.title: Org Groups
org_groups.description: Optional grouping of teams into larger organizational units (tribes, domains, org-units). Distinct from capability groups — org_groups cluster teams, not capabilities.

data_assets.title: Data Assets
data_assets.description: Shared storage and messaging infrastructure. Model data assets when multiple services share the same database, cache, or event stream — this reveals implicit coupling.

external_dependencies.title: External Dependencies
external_dependencies.description: Systems outside the modeled boundary. Define them here; edges showing which services use them come from service.externalDeps.

name.title: System Name
name.description: The name of the system being modeled. Unique identifier for this model.

description.title: System Description
description.description: A description of the system scope and purpose.

version.title: Version
version.description: User-controlled version identifier. Set automatically by the platform on export.

lastModified.title: Last Modified
lastModified.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last export. Set automatically by the serializer.

author.title: Author
author.description: Who last exported or modified this model.

actor.title: Actor
actor.description: A person or external system that has needs (e.g., Merchant, Eater, Operator).

name.title: Actor Name
name.description: The name of the actor. Must be unique within the model and match references from needs.

type.title: Actor Type
type.description: Optional free-form label expressing what kind of actor this is (e.g., User, Customer, Operator, Persona, System). No fixed vocabulary — different organisations use different terms.

description.title: Actor Description
description.description: A description of this actor — who they are and their relationship to the system.

need.title: Need
need.description: What an actor (or multiple actors) is trying to accomplish. Needs bridge actors to capabilities.

name.title: Need Name
name.description: The name of the need. Must be unique within the model.

actor.title: Actor
actor.description: The actor or actors who have this need. Can be a single actor name or a list of actor names.

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: First-person statement of what success looks like for this actor.

fulfilledBy.title: Fulfilled By
fulfilledBy.description: Capabilities that fulfil this need. Each entry is either a capability name (short form) or a relationship object (long form).

capability.title: Capability
capability.description: What the system must be able to do. Capabilities are durable system abilities, not services, technical systems or teams.

name.title: Capability Name
name.description: The name of the capability. Must be unique within the model.

description.title: Capability Description
description.description: A description of what this capability provides.

visibility.title: Visibility
visibility.description: The value chain layer this capability belongs to. user-facing: directly experienced by end users; domain: core business processing; foundational: internal capabilities underpinning domain logic; infrastructure: deep infrastructure.

evolution_stage.title: Evolution Stage
evolution_stage.description: The maturity and stability of this capability. genesis: early-stage, rapidly evolving, likely to change; custom-built: becoming more stable but still evolving; product: well-established and stable; commodity: being phased out or replaced.

strategic_importance.title: Strategic Importance
strategic_importance.description: The strategic importance of this capability to the business. core: essential to the core value proposition; supporting: contributes to competitive differentiation; generic: necessary but not a key differentiator.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: List of tag slugs matching entries in the top-level groups section. A capability can belong to multiple groups.

dependsOn.title: Depends On
dependsOn.description: Other capabilities this capability requires. Each entry is either a capability name (short form) or a relationship object (long form).

technicalSystem.title: Technical System
technicalSystem.description: A concrete implementation that realizes one or more capabilities. Ownership is declared from the team side via team.owns.

name.title: Technical System Name
name.description: The name of the technical system. Must be unique within the model.

description.title: Technical System Description
description.description: A description of what this technical system does.

enables.title: Enables
enables.description: Capabilities this technical system implements. Source of truth for enablement (capabilities do NOT declare enabledBy). Each entry is a capability name or a relationship object with role and description.

constrains.title: Constrains
constrains.description: Capabilities this technical system constrains. Source of truth for constraint (capabilities do NOT declare constrainedBy). Each entry is a capability name or a relationship object with role and description.

dependsOn.title: Depends On
dependsOn.description: Other technical systems this technical system calls. Each entry is a technical system name or a relationship object.

externalDeps.title: External Dependencies
externalDeps.description: Names of external systems this technical system depends on. Must match entries in external_dependencies.

team.title: Team
team.description: An organizational unit that owns capabilities and technical systems. Classified using Team Topologies types.

name.title: Team Name
name.description: The name of the team. Must be unique within the model.

type.title: Team Type
type.description: The Team Topologies classification. stream-aligned: aligned to a flow of work from a segment of the business domain; platform: enables stream-aligned teams to deliver with substantial autonomy; enabling: helps other teams adopt and acquire capabilities; complicated-subsystem: requires specialized knowledge.

description.title: Team Description
description.description: A description of the team — their mission and scope.

size.title: Team Size
size.description: Number of people on the team. Defaults to 5 if not set. Team Topologies recommends 5–9 people per team.

owns.title: Owns
owns.description: Capabilities and technical systems owned by this team. Each entry is a capability or technical system name, or a relationship object.

interacts.title: Interacts
interacts.description: Inline interaction declarations — how this team works with other teams.

teamInteraction.title: Team Interaction
teamInteraction.description: Declares how this team works with another team.

with.title: Target Team
with.description: The name of the other team this team interacts with.

mode.title: Interaction Mode
mode.description: How the two teams work together. x-as-a-service: one team provides a service or API for the other; collaboration: two teams work closely together; facilitating: one team helps the other adopt a capability. Undefined interactions are those that do not fit with the core Team Topologies interaction modes — these are valid but should be used intentionally to highlight awkward interactions that may require special attention.

via.title: Via
via.description: A capability or technical system involved in this interaction.

description.title: Description
description.description: Human-readable label describing the nature of this interaction.

capabilityGroup.title: Capability Group
capabilityGroup.description: Maps a tag slug to a human-readable display name and description. Capabilities reference these via capability.tags.

tag.title: Tag Slug
tag.description: Kebab-case slug. Capabilities reference this via capability.tags.

name.title: Group Name
name.description: Human-readable display name for the group.

description.title: Group Description
description.description: Optional longer description shown in group views.

orgGroup.title: Org Grouping
orgGroup.description: An optional grouping of teams that together provide shared capabilities.

name.title: Grouping Name
name.description: The name of the grouping. Must be unique within the model.

description.title: Grouping Description
description.description: A description of what this grouping provides.

teams.title: Teams
teams.description: Names of teams in this grouping.

externalDependency.title: External Dependency
externalDependency.description: A system outside the modeled boundary. Define it here as a declaration; services declare their use via service.externalDeps.

name.title: External Dependency Name
name.description: The name of the external system. Must be unique within the model and match references in service.externalDeps.

description.title: External Dependency Description
description.description: A description of what this external system provides.

relationship.title: Relationship
relationship.description: A directed relationship reference. Supports two forms: a plain string (short form — just the name) or an object with target, description, and optional role (long form). Both forms can be mixed in the same list.

oneOf.description: Short form: the name of the referenced entity.

target.title: Target
target.description: The name of the referenced entity.

description.title: Description
description.description: An optional human-readable edge label describing the nature of this relationship.

role.title: Role
role.description: The role of this relationship. primary: main implementation or dependency; supporting: contributes but doesn't own; consuming: uses as a client.
